Energy reserves in these slender snakes are limited, and the modest adult body mass imposes constraints on the maximum size of prey items they can subdue and digest. Nonetheless, this value places the species among the longest-lived members of its genus, exceeding the typical 10- to 15-year maximums reported for many similar-sized colubrids.
